summary: INV-13 append-only trigger for findings conflicts with finding_resolutions needing a resolution timestamp on the finding row.
blocking_conditions: Design ambiguity in components.md §6.3 findings vs finding_resolutions

escalation.question: Should resolution state live only in finding_resolutions (findings stay append-only) or may findings.resolved_at be updated?
options: (a) resolution only in finding_resolutions (no design change)
(b) allow single UPDATE of resolved_at (changes INV-13)

recommended_next_action: Lead Architect assessment; operator decision only if (b).
